scoring_methodology.status_thresholds: PASS >= 95% with no High severity; PASS WITH WARNINGS 80-95% or Medium/Low issues present; FAIL < 80% or any High severity

completeness_assessment.issue: No completeness issues identified. All tables, columns, relationships, metrics, and documentation are present and properly mapped between the OSI Semantic Model and Data Dictionary.

accuracy_assessment.issue: No accuracy issues identified. All data types, business definitions, relationship cardinalities, naming conventions, and mappings are consistent and correct between the OSI Semantic Model and Data Dictionary.
accuracy_assessment.recommendation: Continue maintaining data quality and consistency standards.

efficiency_assessment.issue: ETL metadata columns (_source_system, _batch_id, _loaded_at) have identical descriptions repeated across all 8 tables in the Data Dictionary. Each table documents these three columns with the same text, resulting in 24 instances of redundant documentation.
efficiency_assessment.recommendation: Create a shared metadata documentation section or reference that can be applied to all tables, reducing maintenance burden and ensuring consistency. Consider documenting these standard columns once in a 'Common Columns' section and referencing it from each table.

efficiency_assessment.issue: Multiple 'by X' grouping metrics (product_revenue_by_product, revenue_by_customer_segment, revenue_by_sales_channel, revenue_by_product_category, orders_by_status, shipments_by_carrier, payments_by_payment_method) follow nearly identical patterns with only the grouping dimension changing. While each serves a distinct business purpose, the SQL expression structure is highly repetitive.
efficiency_assessment.recommendation: Consider creating a parameterized metric template or base metric definition that accepts the grouping dimension as a parameter, reducing code duplication and simplifying maintenance when aggregation logic needs to change. Alternatively, document the pattern once and reference it to make the relationship between these metrics explicit.
